items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: MRS. STEWART: ...a young student who is terribly talented named Bobby Frankivello... he did one symphonic score for Slam when he was 18

ctx.x: Jack Martin, the one. But a young student who is terribly talented named Bobby Frankivello (PHONETIC), he did one symphonic score for Slam when he was 18 that was quite successful and now he's 19.
